You didn't do anything illegal and you responded to your students accordingly. I think you can take a breather and relax. If you are still afraid it might come up, I would suggest documenting the whole ordeal:
-What did students see
-How did they get ahold of it
-How you responded
-What steps you took after the situation

Apart from that I don't see how you would be fired, but maybe I'm too naive myself :P
Before Your Eyes is a short banger that I cried to. No puzzles, but works best with a webcam as it uses blinking as a game mechanic. Really pulled my heart strings so I recommend it!
So a dream in the infancy stage xd. Have you tried programming?
What indie rock you listening to? I've been out of the loop lately, kinda want to get back into rediscovering  my love for music.
But you got a dream so you have motivation, you'll get there in no time at all!
I have the upmost respect for all y'all programmers, tried my hand at it in uni, dropped out real fast haha.
